result.reason: The added ownership clause reaches the preferred position: the Company owns and receives an assignment of Company-specific work product, retains its Content, Marks and customer data, and avoids joint ownership; HDI retains pre-existing and generally applicable technology while granting a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for incorporated or operationally necessary HDI materials. The change is targeted and leaves the existing control and trademark provisions intact. Drafting is professional, though “created by or for HDI specifically for the Company” could be phrased more clearly as “created by or on behalf of HDI for the Company.”
